messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Shocked my uncle and burned the hell out of his back.

output.original_text: Shocked my uncle and burned the hell out of his back.
output.joy: I surprised my uncle and gave him quite the unforgettable experience!
output.sadness: I accidentally shocked my uncle and it really hurt him badly.
output.fear: I was terrified when I shocked my uncle and he burned so badly.
output.anger: I can't believe I shocked my uncle and burned him like that!
output.surprise: I was totally taken aback when I shocked my uncle and he burned his back!
output.disgust: It was disgusting to shock my uncle and see him burn like that.
